provenance.title: A geometric model for Hochschild homology of Soergel bimodules Introduction

candidates.statement: This should associate to a pair $(G,X)$ a triangulated category $D^b_G(X)$ together with a "forgetting $G$-equivariance" functor $D^b_G(X) \to D^b(X)$.
candidates.section_title: The equivariant derived category and dg-modules

candidates.statement: For any reasonable definition of $D^b_G(X)$, there should be an equivalence $D^b_G(X) \cong D^b(X/G)$ if $G$ acts topologically freely as well as notions of pullback and pushforward for equivariant maps.
candidates.section_title: The equivariant derived category and dg-modules

candidates.statement: However, we must be careful about the difference between dg-modules and modules.

Since we have already described the geometric realization of indecomposable bimodules, as intersection cohomology of subvarieties of $G$, we know abstractly that the Bott-Samelson bimodule $\S\Bi$ must be the hypercohomology of a perverse sheaf obtained by taking a direct sum of $\IC{}$-sheaves of these subvarieties with appropriate multiplicities.
